name: everscript
description: Syntax highlighting, hover docs, and completions for Everscript (.evs) — the Secret of Evermore ROM scripting language

scripts.test: vscode-tmgrammar-test -g code_highlighter/syntaxes/everscript.tmLanguage.json 'code_highlighter/tests/**/*.test.evs' && node memory_radar/tests/radar.test.js && node memory_radar/tests/damage.test.js && node memory_radar/tests/map-blob-evidence-model.test.js && node memory_radar/tests/render-script-model.test.js && node memory_radar/tests/smoke.test.js && node memory_radar/tests/ui.test.js && node memory_radar/tests/scaling-rom.test.js && node debugger/tests/debugger.test.js && node debugger/tests/emulator-health.test.js

program.description: Path to the root .evs file to debug.

entryFunction.description: Name of the function to start execution at.

configurationSnippets.label: Everscript: Debug script
configurationSnippets.description: Step through an .evs script in the mock runtime.

script.description: Path to the root .evs file to compile

everscript.inDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the `in/` directory containing `.evs` source files. Used for static analysis (scope detection, room tree, `#include` resolution). Defaults to `<workspace>/in`.

everscript.patchesDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the `patches/` directory. Used to detect active patches (e.g. `scale_enemies`). Defaults to `<workspace>/patches`.

everscript.romPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Secret of Evermore ROM (`.smc`, no header). Required for the Scaling tab (character stats) and ROM trigger offsets. Defaults to `<workspace>/Secret of Evermore (U) [!].smc`.

everscript.assetsPath.markdownDescription: Path to the assets directory. Should contain an `ingredients/` subfolder with `.webp` ingredient icons. Defaults to the bundled extension assets.

everscript.repoPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Everscript repository root. Sets the build working directory and auto-fills the other build settings. Example: `/path/to/everscript`.

everscript.patchesPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the patches folder passed as `--patches` to the compiler. Defaults to `<repoPath>/patches` when empty.

everscript.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Override: absolute path to `everscript.py` or a compiled binary. Auto-detected from `repoPath` when empty.

everscript.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Override: absolute path to the Python interpreter. Auto-detected from `<repoPath>/.venv/bin/python3` when empty.

everscript.snesCorePath.markdownDescription: Path to a custom `snes9x2005-wasm` Emscripten `.js` build (e.g. `/path/to/snes9x_2005.js`). The matching `.wasm` file must be in the same directory. Leave empty to use the bundled `emulator/core/snes9x_2005.js`.
